routeAuthority.trigger: The user explicitly approved the recommended third texture-assisted/sculpted route after both authorized Blender families retired.

derivedProjection.role: derived implementation aid only; never source authority
derivedProjection.generationMode: built-in imagegen, source-referenced stylized-concept followed by background-only chroma edit
derivedProjection.background: cyan chroma family centered near RGB(0,255,255); runtime removal must be shader-based and edge-safe because alpha generation failed

requiredConstruction: Keep the corrected sealed Blender V2 facade host behind the new relief so both obliques and all rear views remain physically closed and volumetric.

Build the source-derived projection as a subdivided front relief with real vertex depth, not a single flat plane. Use restrained texture-driven displacement or authored depth bands and a small solid rim/side thickness.
Remove the cyan background in the fragment shader using color-distance and edge-softening logic; no cyan rectangle or halo may survive at any review scale.

The relief must sit into and overlap the solid host with no z-fighting, floating gap or paper-edge silhouette. Fade or hand off projection contribution at extreme side/rear angles so the solid host owns those views.
The royal purple bee doorway must be the first focal point, with the smaller embedded rose secondary. The derived projection may not restore the retired rose-first hierarchy.
Honeycomb bays, stacked domes, tower hierarchy, amber glazing, bee emblems, gold-bronze frames and honey drips must survive at phone scale.
The exact source, not the derived projection, governs identity scoring.
strictRejects: flat billboard/card or visible paper edge at 45 or 315 degrees
cyan rectangle, cyan fringe, checkerboard or opaque background
texture floating ahead of or z-fighting with the solid host
projection visible backwards or dominating rear views
door not first and rose not second in front and both obliques
fewer than four countable honeycomb bays at either required oblique
source identity below 0.85 in any required view
more than one bounded correction for this family

capture.gate: Every required category at least 0.85; any billboard/card or chroma-background read is an immediate hard veto. One bounded correction maximum.
